skills.name: phone_call
skills.description: Make an outgoing phone call to a contact name (e.g. 'Dad', 'China Mama', 'Annayya') or phone number (e.g. '+919949617551') through the connected phone plugin (OMyPhone/PipeWire telephony).

recipient.description: Contact name or phone number to call.

skills.name: phone_answer
skills.description: Answer or pick up an incoming phone call.

call_id.description: Optional specific call path. If omitted, automatically answers the active incoming call.

skills.name: phone_hangup
skills.description: Hang up or end the current phone call.

call_id.description: Optional specific call path. If omitted, hangs up the active call.

skills.name: phone_decline
skills.description: Decline or reject an incoming phone call.

call_id.description: Optional specific call path. If omitted, declines the incoming call.

skills.name: phone_mute
skills.description: Mute, unmute, or toggle microphone during a phone call.

action.description: Action to perform on phone call microphone.

skills.name: phone_send_tones
skills.description: Send DTMF keypad tones (digits 0-9, *, #) during an active phone call to navigate automated menus/IVR.

digits.description: Keypad digits or tones to send (e.g. '1', '1234', '*#').

skills.name: phone_list_contacts
skills.description: Search or list contacts synced from the user's phone via OMyPhone.

query.description: Optional contact name or phone number substring to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default 10).

skills.name: phone_recent_calls
skills.description: Get recent call history (all, missed, incoming, outgoing calls).

filter.description: Filter by call direction. Default is 'all'.

limit.description: Maximum number of calls to return (default 10).

skills.name: phone_status
skills.description: Check the current phone and telephony connection status, including connected phone gateways and active calls.

skills.name: phone_open
skills.description: Open or show the OMyPhone phone dialer and contacts panel on the desktop.

skills.name: phone_close
skills.description: Close or dismiss the OMyPhone phone dialer panel on the desktop.
